title: Using interfaces for multiple inheritance of type
answer: Java does not allow a class to extend multiple classes, but a class may implement multiple interfaces. That gives the class multiple type contracts without inheriting conflicting class state. If inherited default methods conflict, the class or a more specific interface must resolve the ambiguity explicitly.
